nodes.name: Schedule Hourly
nodes.notes: Fires at the top of every hour, in the workflow's own timezone (Settings -> Timezone; keep TZ in Analyze in sync).

nodes.name: Manual Check
nodes.notes: On-demand run. POST to it with ?force=1 to post to Slack even when there is nothing new (handy for smoke tests).

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: EDIT HERE to add/remove a watched address. One output item per IP.

nodes.name: Check AbuseIPDB
nodes.notes: Runs once per IP. On failure it still emits one item (carrying "error") so the branch stays aligned with Config by position.

nodes.name: Get State
nodes.notes: No conditions = every row. Runs once, not once per input item.

nodes.name: Merge Config + Response
nodes.notes: Re-attaches ip/label/checkUrl to the matching API response.

nodes.name: Merge State
nodes.notes: Check results plus the stored state rows, into one Code node.

nodes.name: Analyze
nodes.notes: Diffs each IP against its stored report fingerprints, renders the Slack text and decides whether this run is worth posting.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook. The committed copy carries the <<SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL>> placeholder.

nodes.name: Save State
nodes.notes: Written on every run, including runs that post nothing.
